steps.message: I looked at BigApp.csproj -- it's a plain Microsoft.NET.Sdk console project with no custom imports, globs, or property functions, so nothing jumps out just from reading the file.

Rather than guess from source alone, I'd want an actual measurement before proposing anything: capture a binlog (dotnet build BigApp.csproj "-bl:{}") or run with /clp:PerformanceSummary and share the Project Evaluation Performance Summary section. That tells us the real evaluation time and, if it's non-trivial, which specific project(s) or import(s) are involved.

Without a measurement, any specific fix I suggested here would be a guess. Since BigApp.csproj as written doesn't contain any of the known expensive patterns (deep imports, broad globs, expensive property functions), the most useful next step is to capture a binlog (dotnet build BigApp.csproj "-bl:{}") or run with /clp:PerformanceSummary and read the Project Evaluation Performance Summary -- get a real measurement before proposing changes rather than assuming there's a problem to solve.
